newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Ravenswood City SD, Calif..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Ravenswood City SD, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that sealed or facsimile bids will be received by A.M. Peche' & Associates, the Financial Advisor, acting on behalf of the Ravenswood City School District, County of San Mateo, State of California (the District''), for the purchase of $4,700,000* principal amount of Ravenswood City School District, County of San Mateo, California 1997 Tax and Revenue Anticipation Notes at the hour of 10:00 A.M., Pacific Daylight Time, on

at the office of Stradling, Yocca, Carlson & Rauth, 44 Montgomery Street, Suite 2950, San Francisco, California 94104, facsimile number (415) 283-2255. In the event that no bid is awarded, the County and the District will receive bids the next business day and each business day thereafter at the same time and location until such time as a bid is awarded or the County and the District determine to withdraw sale of the Notes. An Official Statement and an Official Notice of Sale relating to the Notes will be furnished upon request to the Financial Advisor at (415) 351-2492.
